say:3:1220220001:0.text: We're back, and we discovered something that could use your help!

narration:4:1220220002:0.text: You tell Hugin about the water shortage in Rustport...
narration:4:1220220002:0.source_cn: 把锈锚港的淡水供应不足的情况告诉了呼金……

say:5:1220220003:1.text: Ah, a water filter system? That sounds...

say:8:1220220006:1.text: A small device that even a craftsman apprentice could make? That doesn't make my blood pump!
say:8:1220220006:1.source_cn: 连工匠学徒都能做的小装置，根本没有灵魂！

say:9:1220220007:1.text: A small device? A filter system for the whole of Rustport would surely be huge!
say:9:1220220007:1.source_cn: 小装置？覆盖整个锈锚港的净化滤水系统怎么可能是个小装置呢？

say:10:1220220008:1.text: Hush. I can already hear Hardhead groaning about wasting time on insignificant purification pipes.
say:10:1220220008:1.source_cn: 饶了我吧，我几乎能听到铁头哀嚎着说，他不想把时间花在和...

say:17:1220220011:0.text: Chippy and I will back you up!
say:17:1220220011:0.source_cn: 那就开始吧，我和满满会好好配合你的！
say:17:1220220011:0.male: Chippy and I will back you up!
say:17:1220220011:0.female: Chippy and I will back you up!

say:21:1220220012:0.text: What are you lot whispering about?
say:21:1220220012:0.source_cn: 你们背着我瞎嘀咕什么呢？

say:22:1220220013:0.text: *Sigh* Who would've thought Hugin wouldn't get it...
say:22:1220220013:0.source_cn: 唉，没想到呼金居然不懂……

say:23:1220220014:1.text: Obviously, this filtration device is incredibly complex! And here Chippy thought Hugin would see the hidden beauty behind it.
say:23:1220220014:1.source_cn: 明明那个滤水装置这么复杂，神秘！

say:24:1220220015:1.text: Hey! Isn't it just an ordinary filter? What's so remarkable about it?
say:24:1220220015:1.source_cn: 喂喂！不就是个普通的滤水装吗？有什么了不起的！

choice_prompt:25:1220220015.text: Hey! Isn't it just an ordinary filter? What's so remarkable about it?
choice_prompt:25:1220220015.source_cn: 喂喂！不就是个普通的滤水装吗？有什么了不起的！

say:26:1220220016:1.text: Huh?! This device lacks profound principles, there's no soul—
say:26:1220220016:1.source_cn: 肤浅？！这种装置根本没有什么高深的原理，没有灵魂——

say:27:1220220018:1.text: *Ahem* Hugin, what the city actually needs is a high-precision solution separation, extraction, and circulation processing device, along with a fully automatic regional coverage system for water circulation!
say:27:1220220018:1.source_cn: 咳，呼金，实际上，主人想要做的是——高精度溶液分离析出...
say:27:1220220018:1.male: *Ahem* Hugin, what the city actually needs is a high-precision solution separation, extraction, and circulation processing device, along with a fully automatic regional coverage system for water circulation!
say:27:1220220018:1.female: *Ahem* Hugin, what the city actually needs is a high-precision solution separation, extraction, and circulation processing device, along with a fully automatic regional coverage system for water circulation!

say:29:1220220020:1.text: Hugin, it's okay if you don't understand. Chippy doesn't understand either!
say:29:1220220020:1.source_cn: 呼金也听不懂对吗，满满也听不懂！不过没关系的！

say:30:1220220021:1.text: Because he said this is advanced knowledge that only a well-learned mage would understand! A simple knight like Chippy, who only knows how to wield a sword, can't possibly get it!
say:30:1220220021:1.source_cn: 因为主人说，这是只有学识丰富的魔法师才懂的高深知识！满...
say:30:1220220021:1.male: Because he said this is advanced knowledge that only a well-learned mage would understand! A simple knight like Chippy, who only knows how to wield a sword, can't possibly get it!
say:30:1220220021:1.female: Because she said this is advanced knowledge that only a well-learned mage would understand! A simple knight like Chippy, who only knows how to wield a sword, can't possibly get it!

say:31:1220220022:1.text: And since dwarves don't use magic, of course it's expected that you don't understand, Hugin!
say:31:1220220022:1.source_cn: 矮人也不会魔法，所以呼金你听不懂也很正常的！

say:32:1220220023:1.text: Hold on! We dwarves may not use magic, but our pursuit of craftmanship is unmatched!
say:32:1220220023:1.source_cn: 矮人是不会魔法，但是我们对技艺的追求独一无二！

say:33:1220220024:0.text: Of course, we all know Hugin's craftmanship is excellent, but the problem is that Hugin has never dealt with high-precision solutions under the influence of magic.
say:33:1220220024:0.source_cn: 我们都知道呼金的技艺很棒，问题是，但呼金肯定没有在魔力...

say:34:1220220025:1.text: Not to mention achieving full automation for the entirety of Rustport, which requires knowledge of geometric and heraldic designs for magic circles...
say:34:1220220025:1.source_cn: 更别说要实现覆盖整个锈锚港的全自动化，这还要用到魔法阵...

say:36:1220220027:1.text: Ah, don't take it to heart, Hugin. If you're not interested, we won't bother you anymore. Worst case scenario, Magister Merlin can just use magic to create one...
say:36:1220220027:1.source_cn: 算啦算啦，呼金你也别放在心上。既然你不感兴趣，那就算了...
say:36:1220220027:1.male: Ah, don't take it to heart, Hugin. If you're not interested, we won't bother you anymore. Worst case scenario, Magister Merlin can just use magic to create one...
say:36:1220220027:1.female: Ah, don't take it to heart, Hugin. If you're not interested, we won't bother you anymore. Worst case scenario, Magister Merlin can just use magic to create one...

say:37:1220220028:1.text: No!! Items created directly by magic have no soul at all!
say:37:1220220028:1.source_cn: ——不行！用魔法直接变出来的东西更没有灵魂！

say:38:1220220029:1.text: And who said I'm not interested?! Don't put words in my mouth! That high... what was it called?
say:38:1220220029:1.source_cn: 而且谁说我不感兴趣？那个什么高精度——叫什么来着？

say:39:1220220030:1.text: The high-precision solution separation, extraction, and circulation processing device, along with a fully automatic regional coverage system for water circulation!
say:39:1220220030:1.source_cn: 高精度溶液分离析出循环处理装置，以及循环流体全自动区域...

say:40:1220220031:0.text: Yes! Isn't it just separation, extraction, and circulation? I know those words! No one else is more fit for the job than me!
say:40:1220220031:0.source_cn: 就是这个！不就是什么什么，分离析出和循环！没有我搞不定的！

narration:46:12020231:0.text: Hugin, having fallen for your tactic, leaves in a huff. Sonja arrives just then and is puzzled by his reaction.
narration:46:12020231:0.source_cn: 被激将法引上钩的呼金气得转身离开，迎面而来的索尼娅见状...

choice:25:0:1.text: You don't see the big picture.
choice:25:0:1.male: You don't see the big picture.
choice:25:0:1.female: You don't see the big picture.

say:47:1220220017:1.text: What is there to understand?! I understand perfectly! Even an apprentice could make a hundred of these! It has no soul—
say:47:1220220017:1.source_cn: 什么叫没听懂，我听得一清二楚！就你们这种需求，没长胡子...

choice:16:0:1.text: Got it, we'll use that tactic.
choice:16:0:1.male: Got it, we'll use that tactic.
choice:16:0:1.female: Got it, we'll use that tactic.
